description: Create LLMEvolutionAdvisor (src/nexus/evolution/llm_evolution.py) - LLM-driven agent and skill evolution with A/B test integration, falling back to existing heuristics.
steps: Create src/nexus/evolution/llm_evolution.py with class LLMEvolutionAdvisor(llm_callable: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]], ab_framework: ABTestFramework | None = None, fallback_agent_evolution: AgentEvolution | None = None, fallback_skill_evolution: SkillEvolution | None = None) containing: suggest_agent_improvements(agent_id: UUID, performance_data: dict) -> dict that prompts LLM with agent performance context and returns structured improvement suggestions (model changes, tool additions, budget adjustments) with rationale. Falls back to AgentEvolution.optimize_model_selection + optimize_tools + optimize_budget on failure; suggest_skill_improvements(skill_id: UUID, performance_data: dict) -> dict that prompts LLM with skill metrics and returns improvement suggestions (prompt rewrites, parameter changes) with rationale. Falls back to heuristic analysis on failure; generate_evolution_hypothesis(context: dict) -> dict that generates a testable hypothesis about what change would improve performance, suitable for feeding into ABTestFramework.design_test; validate_hypothesis(hypothesis: dict, control_results: list[float], treatment_results: list[float]) -> dict that uses ABTestFramework.run_test to validate a hypothesis and returns structured verdict.

Create tests/test_llm_evolution.py with TestLLMEvolutionAdvisor class: test suggest_agent_improvements with mocked LLM returning valid JSON; test suggest_agent_improvements fallback on LLM exception; test suggest_skill_improvements with mocked LLM; test suggest_skill_improvements fallback on invalid JSON; test generate_evolution_hypothesis returns testable hypothesis dict; test validate_hypothesis integrates with ABTestFramework to produce verdict; test with all fallbacks (no LLM available - None-safe).
acceptance_criteria: LLMEvolutionAdvisor follows the established LLM callable pattern (Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]])
All three suggest/generate methods fall back to heuristic logic on any LLM failure
All outputs are structured dicts with documented keys
All new tests pass with mocked LLM (no API keys needed)
verification: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.pyenv/shims:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_llm_evolution.py tests/test_evolution.py --tb=short -q
findings: All 18 new tests pass. Full test suite passes (2136 tests). LLMEvolutionAdvisor supports None llm_callable for graceful degradation. validate_hypothesis does not use LLM at all, delegates directly to ABTestFramework.run_test.
